brief: Prioritise Granite Hollow 230/34kV for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure [MG-023]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Note that the supplied documents do not cover the specific maintenance interval compliance procedure in ERP-031.
